stories.title: Puerto Rico business leaders analyze new rules of competitiveness amidst advancing artificial intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Business leaders in Puerto Rico are talking about how artificial intelligence is changing what it takes to stay competitive in business.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business, you may need to learn how AI tools could help you work faster or serve customers better. This is worth paying attention to.

stories.title: Salinas school district to delete social media accounts over AI privacy concerns
stories.simple_summary: A school district in California is deleting its social media accounts because they worry that artificial intelligence might be collecting private information about students.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows schools are taking seriously the risk that AI could misuse student data. Parents and teachers should know schools are thinking about this.

stories.title: Qantas just showed you how AI will kill white-collar jobs
stories.simple_summary: Qantas airline is using AI in ways that could replace some office jobs that people do today.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in an office doing tasks like scheduling or paperwork, you should start learning new skills. AI will handle routine work, so workers need to develop abilities that machines cannot do.

stories.title: Australia to introduce mandatory reporting after OpenAI hack to combat artificial intelligence ‘going rogue’
stories.simple_summary: Australia is making new rules so that when AI systems go wrong or get hacked, companies must report it to the government.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have a business that uses AI tools, you may need to follow new reporting rules in the future if something goes wrong. It's similar to how restaurants must report health problems.

stories.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic, a company that makes AI software, is planning to sell shares to the public for the first time and set a price for the company this week.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. There's nothing you need to do, though it shows the AI industry is still growing fast.

stories.title: David Ellison says AI could be the ‘biggest creative unlock in modern history’
stories.simple_summary: A Hollywood studio leader thinks artificial intelligence could change movie making as much as special effects did. He believes AI will help filmmakers create new kinds of stories.
stories.why_it_matters: If you watch movies or work in entertainment, AI tools may make production faster and cheaper in the coming years. This could mean new types of films you will see.

stories.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces scrutiny over alleged affair with Chinese spy
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Nvidia, a major computer chip company, is facing questions about a personal relationship with someone accused of spying for China.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly a news story about a public figure's scandal and national security concerns. It does not directly affect your life or business.

stories.title: What could China get from Jensen Huang?
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia makes the computer chips that power most advanced AI systems around the world. The company is extremely powerful and important to the entire AI industry.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large companies. Understanding Nvidia's power helps explain why AI technology keeps advancing, but ordinary people do not need to make decisions based on this.

stories.title: Here’s what Trump said he knew about Jensen Huang
stories.simple_summary: President Trump answered questions about what he knew regarding the Nvidia CEO's personal scandal involving an alleged Chinese spy.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a political and news story. It does not affect how you use AI or run a business.

stories.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling  high-profile sex scandals a year ago
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia's CEO hired a public relations firm a year ago that specializes in handling embarrassing situations for famous people. This was shortly before news broke about his personal life.
stories.why_it_matters: This is part of a scandal involving a company leader. It does not affect how AI works or how you should use it.

stories.title: U.S. Commerce Dept. Inquiry Into Megaspeed Was Halted After Nvidia Intervention
stories.simple_summary: The U.S. Commerce Department stopped investigating a company called Megaspeed after Nvidia got involved.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly relevant to people tracking government investigations and corporate power. It does not affect your daily life or small business operations.

stories.title: Everything we know so far about the Nvidia spy scandal targeting CEO Jensen Huang
stories.simple_summary: The Nvidia CEO has admitted to a personal relationship with a Megaspeed executive. Reports say U.S. intelligence believes that executive may have connections to foreign intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a serious news story about national security and corporate leadership, but it does not change how ordinary people or small businesses use AI tools.
